title.zh: Bithumb Details Internal System Breach: 6,444 Customers and 715 Employees Compro
title.en: Bithumb Details Internal System Breach: 6,444 Customers and 715 Employees Compro

current_state.zh: Bithumb disclosed that an external intrusion into its internal DaouOffice groupware on October 27 exfiltrated personal data of 6,444 customers — including names, phone numbers, resident registration numbers, bank accounts and ID documents, with 844 records directly exposed — plus 715 employee records, while stating that trading systems and asset databases were isolated and customer funds remain secure.
